    LEFT JOIN technicalinfo ti ON nm.netkey = ti.technetref
    LEFT JOIN securitydetection sd ON ti.techkey = sd.sectechref
    GROUP BY a.accindex, sd.detection_score_profile, ma.trustval, ma.impactval, ti.ipcountrynum
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sb.sessref) > 1000 OR SUM(cb.postfreq) > 50
    ORDER BY cross_risk_score DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT ta.account_id, ta.cross_risk_score,
    ti.vpnratio, ti.proxycount, ti.ipcountrynum,
    ROUND(CAST(
        0.4 * COALESCE(ti.vpnratio, 0) 
        + 0.3 * (COALESCE(ti.proxycount, 0)::numeric / 10) 
        + 0.3 * (COALESCE(ti.ipcountrynum, 0)::numeric / 20)
    AS numeric), 4) AS tei_score
FROM top_accounts ta
JOIN profile p ON ta.account_id = p.profaccref
JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
LEFT JOIN networkmetrics nm ON sb.sessref = nm.netsessref
LEFT JOIN technicalinfo ti ON nm.netkey = ti.technetref
